paragraphs: The Evoque P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine that was introduced in 2016 with the L538 generation facelift and carried over into the current L551 model. This engine is part of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family and replaced earlier Ford EcoBoost petrol units in the Evoque range. The P250 sits above the P200 in the petrol lineup, offering higher power output while sharing the same engine architecture. No widely-reported engine issue for this variant — we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey. Range Rover Evoque P250 Engine Compatibility The Evoque P250 uses the same Ingenium AJ200P engine across both L538 (2016-2018) and L551 (2019-present) generations, though there are differences in engine management and ancillary fitment between the two. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque P250 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ200P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200P rebuild.
